lines.name: Rivalz
lines.text: I love playing against the nobility!

lines.name: Rivalz
lines.text: When they lose they always pay out of pride!

lines.name: Rivalz
lines.text: By the way, 8 minutes and 32 seconds is a new record

lines.name: Lelouch
lines.text: He also didn't have much time to move either

lines.name: Lelouch
lines.text: And as opponents go...

lines.name: Rivalz
lines.text: Well then why don't you challenge one of the elevens, they're NOTHING like us Britannians

lines.name: Rivalz
lines.text: Huh...

lines.name: Nearby Male Britannian
lines.text: What are they trying to prove by killing innocent people?!

lines.name: Nearby Female Britannian
lines.text: Those Elevens terrify me!

lines.name: News Anchor
lines.text: We apologise for the delay

lines.name: News Anchor
lines.text: Now, his royal highness Prince Clovis, 3rd Prince of Britannia, will address the nation

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: To all my Imperial subjects...

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: Inlcuding of course, the many cooperative Elevans who...

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: choose to serve the Empire of Brtiannia

lines.name: Mysterious Voice
lines.text: We're not Elevens, we're JAPANESE!

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: Do you not see my pain?

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: My heart was...

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: RIPPED...

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: from my chest, only to be torn apart...

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: the remnants are filled with rage and sadness

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: However, as ruler of Area 11, I will not tolerate terrorism of any kind!

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: Because the battle we fight is a RIGHTEOUS one!

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: A virtuous battle to protect the wellbeing of one and all!

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: Now, everyone I would like you to join me in observance of the eight who...

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: died for justice in the line of duty...

lines.name: News Anchor
lines.text: A moment of silence now please...

lines.name: Rivalz
lines.text: Well aren't you going to join in?

lines.name: Lelouch
lines.text: Aren't you?

lines.name: Rivalz
lines.text: Heh... it's sort of embarassing

lines.name: Lelouch
lines.text: And I agree with you

lines.name: Lelouch
lines.text: Besides, spilling tears over those people won't bring them back to life, now will it?

lines.name: Rivalz
lines.text: Dang! Thats dark buddy!

lines.name: Lelouch
lines.text: It's all about self satisfaction...

lines.name: Lelouch
lines.text: It doesn't matter how hard you try, you can't do it...

lines.name: Lelouch
lines.text: There's no way you can change the world

lines.name: Party Goers
lines.text: You were magnificent, your highness!

lines.name: Party Goers
lines.text: One would never guess that you were attending a party whilst doing that!

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: Well!

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: After all the viceroy is the markey actor of Area 11, I need to change costumes quickly

lines.name: Party Goers
lines.text: My... You're so self confident!

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: It's all in the performance...

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: Since the media want a charismatic prince, I give them one

lines.name: Party Goers
lines.text: Untrue! Prince Clovis, our key purpose in life is to support and assist your reign in anyway we can!

lines.name: Diethard
lines.text: Tsch...

lines.name: Diethard
lines.text: His reign is a pathetic sham...

lines.name: Bartley
lines.text: Yo-your highness!!

lines.name: Diethard
lines.text: Hmm? A soldier?

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: How borish of you

lines.name: Bartley
lines.text: I beg your pardon, your highness

lines.name: Diethard
lines.text: Not another appearance for him? I hope it's not as dreary...

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: You FOOL!!

lines.name: Bartley
lines.text: The police where informed that it was 'Medical Equipment' thats all...

lines.name: Bartley
lines.text: If we scramble the army there'll be a reco-

lines.name: Prince Clovis
lines.text: Deploy the Royal Guard! The knightmares aswell!
